killReason: Killed in validation on 21 Nov 2026 by lead Yash. The gap is already closed for free: BreedTools runs a free, no account, on device litter weight tracker with a growth chart per puppy and printable records (https://breedtools.com/tools/weight-tracker), and it ranks on page one for whelping calculator; Puppy Scales is a free app that does the same (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1579589173); EZwhelp gives free whelping and litter weight forms (https://www.ezwhelp.com/pages/whelping-forms). This overturns the earlier gap item that said no free tracker charts weights per puppy. Search, our only channel, is too small where intent is breeder: US Google Ads monthly averages for the last 12 months from DataForSEO (keywords/search-volume, location 2840, pulled 21 Nov 2026 through Firecrawl Alexandria) are whelping chart 110, puppy weight tracker 40, whelping record 30, puppy weight tracker app 10, litter tracker 10, litter weight chart 10, newborn puppy weight chart 10, and null for litter record template and puppy weight log. The bigger terms are owner intent and owned by brands: puppy growth chart 4400 and puppy weight chart 880, where page one is Waltham, Iams, Sydney Animal Hospitals, puppyweights.com, AKC, Omni Calculator and Pearson; whelping calculator 390 is a due date tool, already served free by gundogcentral, BreedTools, Leerburg and others. Paid signals are thin: Whelper 17 ratings, Breedera 38 ratings, Breeder Tracker and Puppy Tracker too few ratings to show, and Etsy breeder templates sell at $1.29 to $9.99. Search results are also full of parasite template pages on high authority university and government domains, which a new subdomain cannot outrank soon. Realistic first year revenue through search alone is near zero.
title: Litter Log
oneLiner: Phone log for small dog breeders: whelping times, daily puppy weights with growth charts and a buyer-ready puppy record
customer: Small hobby dog breeders with one to five litters a year

evidence.claim: Whelper, a breeding companion app with whelping countdown and puppy weight graphs, charges $6.99 a month or $69.99 a year, with 17 ratings averaging 4.9.
An Etsy dog breeder spreadsheet with a whelping calculator and puppy weight log sells for $9.99 (down from $19.99), though the listing has no reviews yet and the shop shows 27 sales.
Gap and search: free printable puppy weight chart and whelping chart searches return mostly parasite template pages on unrelated domains, not a working free tracker that charts weights per puppy.
Breedera, a dog breeder app with litter profiles, puppy weight growth charts and whelping countdown, sells a Complete Package at $9.99 a month or $99.99 a year, with 38 ratings averaging 4.2.
Breeder Tracker, an app with puppy weight charts and a whelping contraction timer, sells Pro at $6.99 or $49.99 a year, but has too few ratings for the App Store to show an average.
Puppy Tracker, a litter weighing app with growth charts, sells Premium as a $5.99 one-time purchase, but has too few ratings for the App Store to show an average.
An Etsy dog breeder planner PDF with a litter tracker and whelping log sells for $1.29 (down from $3.90) from a shop with 351 sales.

Against: BreedTools offers a free puppy and litter weight tracker for breeders with no account, data kept on the device, every puppy on one growth chart, and printable records, and it ranks on page one for breeder terms such as whelping calculator.
Against: Puppy Scales, a free app with no listed in-app purchases, already logs daily weights per puppy by collar colour for several litters, graphs growth across the litter and exports reports.
Against: EZwhelp gives away a free whelping chart, a 63 day perpetual whelping chart and a puppy litter weight record to download.

nextAction: None. Killed on 21 Nov 2026; see killReason. Lesson for screening: check for a free no account tool on the exact job (here BreedTools) before staffing.
